keySentence: He kept trading until he had nothing left.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Gold, horse, cow, pig, goose, stone. The stone fell in a well. He had nothing. He kept trading until he had nothing left.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Hans had traded from gold all the way down to a stone. Then the heavy stone fell into a well and was gone. He kept trading until he had nothing left at all. Most people would cry about losing everything. But Hans looked at the sky and laughed out loud. He felt lighter and happier than ever before.
facts.Word cards: In the end = 결국 / nothing = 아무것도 없는 / happy = 행복한 / heart = 마음 / free = 자유로운
